name: core-fields
description: Three facts a repository review asks of every contract. Each is an ordinary question run; the value is the first finding whose citation verified.

fields.label: Governing law and forum
fields.question: What law governs this agreement and where must disputes be brought?

fields.label: Termination
fields.question: On what grounds and with how much notice may a party terminate this agreement?

fields.label: Liability cap
fields.question: What is the cap on each party's liability?
